answer.short:
$x=50$.

Use the triangle's interior-angle sum of $180^\circ$.
answer.worked:
Let $x$ be the numerical value of the angle labelled $x^\circ$. The interior angles of a triangle add to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}(x+10)+(x+20)+x&=180\\3x+30&=180\\3x&=150\\x&=50\end{align*}$$
Check: $60^\circ+70^\circ+50^\circ=180^\circ$.
